spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is a real photo of the National Taiwan Library; image 4 is a real photo of the library's main entrance; image 5 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Night on the wide paved plaza in front of the National Taiwan Library in No. 4 Park, from images 3 and 4: the modern library building with a glowing teal-blue glass facade, a red-brick arched arcade wing, trees and soft garden lights, a deep blue night sky. On the plaza in front of the library the man stands facing the woman and looks at her earnestly, mouth closed; she covers her mouth with one hand, smiling, about to nod. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the man keeps EXACTLY his model-sheet look: black rectangular glasses, short swept black hair, navy cotton overshirt worn open over a white crewneck T-shirt, khaki chinos, white canvas sneakers, black backpack; the woman keeps EXACTLY her model-sheet look: half-up princess-style wavy dark-brown hair with twisted strands at the back, oatmeal knit sweater, sage-green pleated midi skirt, white low sneakers, small tan leather crossbody bag. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
